method: deterministic isolated mathematical model; no live API, actual browser, or engine
assumptions: initial full GET and command POST excluded from steady periodic GET counts

nonzeroRttRateFormula: For a seat: 60 / (chosen_delay_seconds + state_RTT_seconds + awaited_pending_reconciliation_seconds) periodic GETs/minute; sum across active seats.
realLimitations: Browser background throttling/suspension can extend both polling and 550ms submission timers without bound.
A stale lobby view keeps the slower cadence until it discovers playing; this proposal improves playing-to-turn discovery, not lobby-to-start discovery.
